headline: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump and Pope Leo
text: Hundreds were evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during a localized ceasefire brokered by first lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo XIV; the truce, the longest since Russia's 2022 invasion, expires Sunday evening.

headline: US federal judge orders ethics inquiry into Trump administration lawyers over golf course case
text: A US federal judge ordered an ethics inquiry into Trump administration lawyers over the East Potomac Golf Links case after they failed to disclose redevelopment plans that President Trump announced on social media.
